Info

Structural protocol for computing SCARA robot workspace inner deadzone boundaries.

class scarajectory.core.service.kinematics.iscara_deadzone_calculator.IScaraDeadzoneCalculator(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining SCARA kinematic inner deadzone boundary calculations.

It defines:

methods:
calculate_deadzone_radius - Calculates inner deadzone radius in millimeters.
calculate_deadzone_radius_squared - Calculates squared inner deadzone radius.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
calculate_deadzone_radius(l1: float, l2: float, j2_max_rad: float) → float[source]¶

Calculates inner workspace deadzone radius boundary in millimeters.

Parameters:

  • l1 – Length of primary arm link in millimeters.

  • l2 – Length of secondary forearm link in millimeters.

  • j2_max_rad – Maximum joint 2 angle limit in radians.

Returns:

Minimum unreachable inner radius in millimeters.

calculate_deadzone_radius_squared(l1: float, l2: float, j2_max_rad: float) → float[source]¶

Calculates squared inner workspace deadzone radius.

Parameters:

  • l1 – Length of primary arm link in millimeters.

  • l2 – Length of secondary forearm link in millimeters.

  • j2_max_rad – Maximum joint 2 angle limit in radians.

Returns:

Squared inner deadzone radius.
